text_injection: Each text data-var element contains one styled <span> (font, size, weight, color live here) wrapping an empty <span class="sc-interp">. Inject the value into span.sc-interp. Do not restyle or replace the outer span.
shrink_to_fit: Not performed by the static HTML. The rendering engine must apply it: start at data-fit-base (px), reduce the outer span font-size until the text fits the data-var box width, never below data-fit-min (px). Fields: agent_name (22 -> 16 px = 12 pt), agent_email (14 -> 10.67 px = 8 pt), agent_slug (13 -> 10.67 px = 8 pt).

qr_caption.notes: LOCKED artwork, below qr_zone (outside quiet zone). Same position on all 8 templates. Not a variable field.
